title: Pick parts needs only Work orders View, not Create & Edit
preconds: 1. A user has a role with Work orders View only (Create & Edit and Delete OFF), Pick parts ON and the Parts Department card ON.
steps:
1. Log in and open a work order.
  2. Find a Pick parts action.
  3. Pick parts from inventory onto a line.
  4. Save.
  5. Move a part from one line to another on the same work order.
  6. Move a part between two different work orders.
expected:
The Pick parts action is available even without Create & Edit on Work orders.

The pick and the moves all work.
